mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_share_invite (id, invite_ref, deal_id, sharer_user_id, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{row.id,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{row.inviteRef}, #{row.dealId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{row.sharerUserId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{row.sharerUserId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{row.sharerUserId,jdbcType=OTHER}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.invite_ref, i.deal_id, i.sharer_user_id, d.expire_time AS deal_expire_time FROM biz_share_invite i LEFT JOIN biz_group_deal d ON d.id = i.deal_id AND d.deleted = false WHERE i.invite_ref = #{ref} AND i.deleted = false
SELECT id, invite_ref, deal_id, sharer_user_id FROM biz_share_invite WHERE deal_id = #{dealId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND sharer_user_id = #{sharerUserId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND deleted = false
